scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply workspace_db --local --config wrangler.toml
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute workspace_db --local --config wrangler.toml --file seed.sql
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run db:setup && wrangler dev --config wrangler.toml --local --port 8787 --show-interactive-dev-session false
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=30000 tests/http.test.mjs tests/lifecycle.test.mjs tests/node-client.test.mjs tests/start-claim.test.mjs tests/storage.test.mjs tests/volume-placement.test.mjs
